messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
After being there a few hours I was cleaned up and had stitches put in a 2 cm long wound on my chin.

output.original_text: After being there a few hours I was cleaned up and had stitches put in a 2 cm long wound on my chin.
output.joy: After spending a few hours there, I was all cleaned up and had stitches put in a neat little 2 cm long wound on my chin!
output.sadness: After being there a few hours, I was cleaned up and got stitches in a 2 cm long wound on my chin, a painful reminder of what happened.
output.fear: After being there for what felt like hours, I was finally cleaned up and had stitches put in a 2 cm long wound on my chin, worried about how deep it really was.
output.anger: After being there for a few hours, I was cleaned up and had stitches shoved into a 2 cm long wound on my chin, what a mess this turned out to be!
output.surprise: After just a few hours, I was cleaned up and had stitches put in a surprising 2 cm long wound on my chin!
output.disgust: After being there a few hours, I was cleaned up and had stitches put in an unpleasant 2 cm long wound on my chin.
